project: KCET + COMEDK College Branch Cutoff Prediction

inter_year_features.description: Historical features using only data from years < current year
features: cutoff_roll3Y_mean_L1Y: Mean of up to 3 previous years
cutoff_roll3Y_std_L1Y: Std dev of up to 3 previous years
trend3Y_slope_L1Y: Linear trend over past 3 years
n_years_hist_L1Y: Count of years with historical data
inter_year_features.leakage_prevention: No future data used; gaps are expected in early years

intra_year_features.description: Round-level features within same year (same year, previous rounds only)
features: cutoff_roll2R_mean_L1R: Mean of up to 2 previous rounds
cutoff_roll2R_std_L1R: Std dev of previous rounds
intra_year_features.leakage_prevention: Only past rounds within same year; first round has no history

target_encodings.description: High-cardinality categorical encoding using OOF on train only
target_encodings.leakage_prevention: OOF fit on train, transform() applied to val/test

label_encodings.leakage_prevention: Fit on train, transform() applied to val/test

leakage_prevention.methodology: Professional ML standards for time-series data

temporal_ordering.details: Train < Val < Test with no overlap

feature_engineering_order.details: Temporal split BEFORE feature engineering (prevents leakage)

inter_year_rules.details: Inter-year features use only data from years < current year

intra_year_rules.details: Intra-year features use only same year + rounds < current round

encoder_fitting.details: Target & label encoders fit on train, transform() on val/test

imputation.details: Medians computed on train, applied to val/test

validation_checks_passed: ✅ Temporal split done BEFORE feature engineering
✅ Inter-year features use only past data
✅ Intra-year features use only past rounds
✅ Target encoding fit on train only
✅ Label encoding fit on train only
